reason: I only use tools my guru's playbook names, and this isn't one of them. No customer results, 7 seats sold, and a card up front with 'payments final' after day 3 reads like a trap, so I'd skip it.
objection: Zero published results, and a 3-day trial that auto-bills with no refunds. Three days isn't enough time to see if cold DMs even book calls, and I'd be putting my real Instagram account behind a tool nobody has proven.
would_change_my_mind: A guru I already follow using it, or a few real customers showing booked calls from it, plus a 7-day trial or a refund window after the first charge.
